When you enter this tile, draw 1d12 cards, keep 1. (Dungeon Timer rarity). End your turn.
When you enter The Moonlit Chapel, secretly take 1–5 dice into your hand. Other players guess how many dice you handle. -> Correct guesses: heal 1d20HP. -> If no one is correct: you loot Coffin.

When you arrive on this tile: You may play, or move to a random tile for free. Anyone may join the game by discarding 1. Roll 2d6 : Any 1 -> end your turn. No 1 -> everybody loot Common, you can reroll for higher : Unco -> Rare -> Epic -> Legendary.

When you enter this tile, choose one (or two if you are wearing gold gear) from the Merchant : 1. Birkin Purge — Discard all Consumables. Loot 1 Turn-rarity Gear (or two if you are wearing gold gear). 2. Royal Oak Fitting — Draw X Turn-rarity Gear, where X = your Chaos. Keep 1 (or two if you are wearing gold gear).
When you enter this tile, play Rock-Paper-Scissors with all players. -> Losers: Enter combat with a Sub-Boss. -> Winner: Get the loot of the Sub-Boss if defeated.
When you enter this tile, roll 1d20+AGI. -> 1–13 : Draw a Trap. -> 13+ : No effect.

When entering the Squire Spa, choose one : 1. Purifying Bath — Heal 2d10HP. 2. Exfoliation — Loot 1 card (dungeon turn rarity). If you have already visited The Squire Spa: you cannot choose an option. Take 1d20 dmg and get kicked to a random tile.

When entering the Squire Spa, choose one : 1. Purifying Bath — Heal 2d10HP. 2. Exfoliation — Loot 1 card (dungeon turn rarity). If you have already visited The Squire Spa: you cannot choose an option. Take 1d20 dmg and get kicked to a random tile.
When you enter this tile, roll 1d20 + AGI. 1-19: Take 1d12 dmg and get moved to a new tile. 20+ : Stay on the tile. Partyhard targets, Invited & Aristocrats enter freely.
When you arrive this tile decide : 1. Rookie — Fight 1 Mob. -> success: loot +Rare. 2. Pro — Fight 2 Mobs -> success: loot +Legendary. End your turn.
When you arrive this tile decide : 1. Rookie — Fight 1 Mob. -> success: loot +Rare. 2. Pro — Fight 2 Mobs -> success: loot +Legendary. End your turn.
When you enter roll 1d6: -> 2 : Loot Common Consumable. -> 3 : Loot Unco Consumable. -> 4 : Loot Rare Consumable. -> 5 : Loot Epic Consumable. -> 6 : Loot Legendary Consumable.
When you enter this tile, if Astragor is alive, enter combat immediately. Otherwise, move to a random tile.
When you enter this tile, if Gladiator is alive, enter combat immediately. Otherwise, move to a random tile.
When you enter this tile, if Frost Wyvern is alive, enter combat immediately. Otherwise, move to a random tile.
When you enter this tile, play Rock-Paper-Scissors with all players. -> Losers: Enter combat with a Boss. -> Winner: Get the loot of the Boss if defeated.

When you enter each player secretly discards cards, then reveal. -> Most discarded : loot Legendary + all discarded cards. -> Tie : all discarded cards vanish. Both take 1d20 dmg. -> Everyone chose 0: you loot Legendary.

When entering the Squire Spa, choose one : 1. Hot Bath — Heal 1d20 HP. Gain as much Fire (Dungeon duration). 2. Minor Scrub — Loot 1d6 Common. If you have already visited The Squire Spa: you cannot choose an option. Take 1d20 dmg and get kicked to a random tile.
During his turn, The Guard may move here if this tile is visible.

When you enter this tile, you may Leap to a revealed Tile. If you do so, roll 1d20 + AGI : -> 25+: Enter combat with First Strike and +5 Lightning. -> 1–24: Take xd6 Fire damage for each Plate equipped. End your turn.
